content: Balanabasi yi Sawulu babatumi mu kitambu
Muna Dibundu dina dyákala ku Atyosi, mwákala yi bambikudi yi balongi bwosu: Balanabasi, Simeyoni wuna bakala tela Kaphindi, Lukyusi mwisi Sileni, Manayena wuna wakola kumosi yi Eloti
wuna wakala yala ku Ngadidi yi Sawulu.
Muna tangwa dina bakala zatula Pfumu yi kuzila madya, Kitembu Kyatoma wuzimbudini: «Ngyekwalenu Balanabasi yi Sawulu kikuma kya kisalu kina yíbatedila.»
Hanga ku manima ma kuzila madya yi kulombila, babasya moku amana bábasula ni benda.
Balanabasi yi Sawulu ku Siphe
Disongidila, bawu bátuma kwena Kitembu Kyatoma, bákulumuka ku Selesi; amana kwakuna, bákota mu masuwa ndangu benda ku zawala dya Siphele.
Buna bátula ku Salamini, básamuna ndinga ya Nzambi muna nzu za kimvuka za Bayuta. Bákala yi Yowani-Malaku wuna wákala waphamu dya bawu.
Kunima dya kulabuka zawala dyosu yi kuna Phafwosi, báwana nganga-ngombu mosi, Muyuta mosi khumbu yandi Badi-Yesu wakala dimonikisa hanga mbikudi.
Kakala zingila mu mukombu wa pfumu wa zawala Seluyusi Phawulusi, mutu mosi wa mayedi. Yandi wátedisa Balanabasi yi Sawulu, mu kusanda kayuka Ndinga ya Nzambi.
Kaasi nganga-ngombu Edimasi (bwosu buna bakala mutela mu ngeleti), kakala batendisa amana kakala sanda mu kumuhukumuna pfumu wa zawala mu lukwikilu.
Hanga Sawulu (wuna bisi tela hika Pholu), wábasa yi Kitembu Kyatoma, wámutala Edimasi
amana wuzimbudi: «Ngeyi mutu yandu wabasa yi bukamvi yi mayedi mambi, mwana wa kiphidi-mutu, mbeni wa masonga! Wayambulaku kuzanga nzila za bukheti za Pfumu?

Buthwena, koku dya Pfumu dyakúzyatula ngeyi: wakítuka phofu, amana mu tangwa dimosi, wamónaku hika mwini wa tangwa.» Muna tangwa meni dina, phipha yámubwila, wáyandika mu kubabata ndangu kasanda mutu wamúsimba.
Tangwa kámona, pfumu wa zawala mana mabwa, wákwikila, wáyuka tsambu lawu kikuma kya malongi ma Pfumu.
Pholu yi Balanabasi ku Atyosi wa Phisidi
Pholu yi banduku bandi bákota mu masuwa ma Phafosi, bénda phi ku mbanza ya Pheleze dya Phafidiya. Yowani-Malaku yandi wádihambula yi bawu amana wávutuka ku Yelusalemi.
Tuka ku mbanza Pheleze, bálanda nzila ya bawu amana bátula ku Atyosi wa Phisidi. Kilumbu kya sabata, bákota mu nzu ya kimvuka ya Bayuta amana bázakala.
Ku manima ma kutanga Mitsiku yi Bambikudi mu ndinga ya ngolu, bapfumu ba nzu ya kimvuka ya Bayuta bátuma benda bazimbwala: «Baphangi, yukani ndinga lwenina yawu kikuma kya kusyamisa batu, zonzenu.»
Pholu wátelama, wusongidi kidimbu ku koku amana wuzimbudi: «Bisi Kiseledi yi benu lwisi muzitisa Nzambi, yukenu!
Nzambi wa kikanda kyaki, Nzambi wa Kiseledi kásola batata betu amana wávudisa kikanda mu tangwa dina kyákala mu kinzenza ku tsi ya Ngiphiti, kunima wálubulakya mu ngolu za koku dyandi.
Wábadisa kitesu kya mvula makumaya muna nganga.
Amana ku manima kuzilula makanda tsambwadi muna tsi ya Kanana, wábaheka tsi ya bawu hanga kimvwama
moosu mana másalama mu kitesu kya mvula khama ya yi makumatanu. «Ku manima ma bwabuna, wábaheka bazusi tii yi kuna tangwa dya mbikudi Samwela.
Ku manima, bálomba kyamvu, Nzambi wábaheka Sawulu, mwana Kisi, wuna wábayala mu mvula makumaya. Mukwa kikanda kya Benzyame kákala.

Ku manima ma kumukatula, wábasodila kyamvu Tavidi ndangu kakala pfumu wa bawu. Wáta kimbangi kikuma kya yandi: "Yimusodi Tavidi mwana wa Yese: mutu yandu wufwanani yi mabanza mama, kalúngisa bwosu buna nzodi."
Muna kikanda kyandi, Nzambi, muna lusilu lwandi kátedisila Yesu hanga muhuludi kikuma kya Kiseledi.
Ku thwala kukwisa kwandi, Yowani wábekitila kikuma kya mbotika ya tsobuka ya bikalulu ya kanda dyosu dya Kiseledi.
Amana Yowani buna kákala manisa kisalu kyandi, kákala zimbula: "Kwena benu, nati yenina meni? Meni yenabwoku! Ku manima ma meni kabati kwisila wuna yiléndaku mu kutumuna tsabatu zandi."
«Baphangi bama ba kikanda kya Bulahami yi benu lwisi muzitisa Nzambi, Musamu wa luhulusu wuna, kwena betu báhitikawa.
Mukuma, bisi Yelusalemi yi bapfumu ba bawu bámubakulaku Yesu, bábakisaku phi ndinga za bambikudi zina bisi tanga mu kosu kilumbu kya sabata. Kaasi bálungisaza mu kumusambisa.
Mbatanana bakonda mona kikuma kya kumuzengila lufwa, bálomba kwena Philatu ni kamuhondisa.
Ku manima ma kulungisa moosu mana básonika mu Masonuku kikuma kya yandi, bámukulumuna ha kitakani amana bámuzesa muna mazyamu.
Kaasi Nzambi wámufutumuna ha kati dya bafwa.
Kádimonikisa bilumbu bya lawu kwena bana bámusindikila tuka ku Ngadidi yi kuna Yelusalemi, amana buthwena bákituka bambangi bandi ku thwala ya bisi Kiseledi.
Amana betu, tulusamwani Musamu wa Bukheti wawu: lusilu luna kásila kwena batata betu,
Nzambi wulungisima buthwena kikuma kya betu bana ba bawu, mu kufutumuna Yesu. Bwosu buna básonika mu mukanda wazodi wa mikunga:
Nzambi kázimbula: kamúfutumuna ku bafwa ndangu kavutukaku hika mu bivundisila. Bwabuna kázonzila:
Ihana kázonzila muna mukunga wahika:

content.text: "Wayámbwadilaku ni Watoma waku kavundila mu mazyamu."

content: Kinga, ku manima ma kusadisa mu makula mandi bwosu buna kázola Nzambi; Tavidi wáfwa, bámuzika hana kabeta ka batata bandi amana wávunda.
Kaasi wuna káfutumuna Nzambi, kávundaku.
Zayenubwoku, baphangi bama: mwena yandi bisi lulongila ndoluka ya masumu; muna moosu mana myáfwanaku kululolula mitsiku mya Moyize,
muna moosu meni mamana, wosu wuna wukwikidi mwena yandi kakútumuka.
Disongidila ni kebenu, malubwilaku mana básonika Bambikudi:

content.text: Mukuma meni, yilúngisa muhangu wumosi muna tangwa dyenu, muhangu wumosi wuna lwakonda kwikila, yuka ni balumenikawa!»

content: Mu kulubuka kwa Pholu yi Balanabasi, bábabokwadila mu kuzonzila hika dyambu dina mu kilumbu kya sabata kina kyálanda.

Tangwa kyámwangana kimvuka, Bayuta balawu yi baphani bana bakwikila mu malongi ma Bayuta bana bisi kumisa Nzambi, bálanda Pholu yi Balanabasi. Baba-baba, muna ngyambila za bawu kumosi yi bawu, bakala basyamisa mu kukangama ku khenda za Nzambi.
Sabata dina dyálanda, mbanza yosu kwandi bákutakana mu kuyuka ndinga ya Nzambi.
Mu kumona milumba-lumba mya batu, Bayuta bahika báyuka kiphala; bákala mufindisa phaka Pholu yi ngusi.

Hanga Pholu yi Balanabasi bakala bazimbwala yi kikumbwala kyosu: «Bwálunga ni baluzimbwalaya, ndinga ya Nzambi, theti kwena benu. Kaasi bwosu lulewudiya amana lumoniki ni lufwaniku mu kutambula luzingu lwa mvula yi mvula, tubaluki kwetu kwena Baphani.
Mukuma Pfumu wátuheka muswa wawu:

content.text: ndangu, mu lusadisu lwa ngeyi, luhulusu lwatula

content: Buna báyuka bwabuna, Baphani básangwala lawu, bázatula Pfumu kikuma kya ndinga yandi. Amana boosu bana káyidika Nzambi kikuma kya luzingu lwa mvula yi mvula bákwikila.
Ndinga ya Pfumu yámwangana mu mulambu wosu.
Kaasi Bayuta bábalundika bakhetu ba luzitu bana bakala kumisa Nzambi yi bambuta ba mbanza amana bábasosila munyanga Pholu yi Balanabasi amana bábakukwasa mu mulambu wa bawu.
Bawu, bábakhukwamina fusyangeni dya bitambi bya bawu
amana bénda ku Kikonyumi.
Kaasi balonguki ba ku Atyoki wa Phisidi, bawu, bábasa yi kyesi yi Kitembu Kyatoma.

footnotes.text: Yandu-yandu kákala Eloti Atiphasi wuna wásenda kwena phumbulu mosi mu kumuhonda Yowani Mubotiki (Luk 9:7-9)
Mu kukhukumuna fusyangeni dya bitambi bya bawu, kyákala kidimbu mu kusongila ni batu bana babwisiwa musamu. Mambu mana matadiku hika bamwangi tsangu, kaasi matadi batu meni bana.
